findings.title: Existing depositors' accrued yield can be diluted by pre-report deposits because factory deployments disable profit locking
findings.summary: Strategy4626Factory sets profitMaxUnlockTime to zero. A depositor can enter before a report recognizes accrued stETH/wstETH/ERC4626 profit and immediately receive a pro-rata share of yield earned before they deposited.
findings.impact: Yield dilution for existing depositors; attacker captures prior unreported profit rather than principal.
findings.recommendation: Do not set profitMaxUnlockTime to zero by default. Preserve a non-zero unlock period or close/report/reopen deposits around material unreported profit.

findings.title: Manual LST-to-WETH swaps expose discounted liquidity before accounting records the loss
findings.summary: manualSwapToAsset can realize a Curve/stETH loss and expose WETH immediately via availableWithdrawLimit while TokenizedStrategy.totalAssets remains stale until report.
findings.impact: First redeemers can avoid realized losses, shifting more than their pro-rata loss to remaining holders.
findings.recommendation: Atomically account realized losses before withdrawals, or gate availableWithdrawLimit after manual/emergency swaps until a report records the new value.

findings.title: Post-shutdown reports can re-stake emergency-withdrawn WETH and block withdrawals again
findings.summary: _harvestAndReport stakes idle WETH without checking TokenizedStrategy.isShutdown. Because reports remain callable after shutdown, a report can redeploy WETH freed by emergencyWithdraw.
findings.impact: Emergency recovery can be undone by a keeper report, returning maxRedeem to zero and delaying user withdrawals.
verification: env ETH_RPC_URL=https://ethereum.publicnode.com forge test -vv --fork-url https://ethereum.publicnode.com --match-path src/test/ShutdownReportRedeployPoC.t.sol -> 1 passed
findings.recommendation: In _harvestAndReport, avoid staking idle WETH when TokenizedStrategy.isShutdown is true; add shutdown-specific regression coverage.

findings.title: Strategy4626 emergencyWithdraw does not materially free the normal ERC4626-held position
findings.summary: The inherited emergency withdraw path checks only loose stETH. Normal Strategy4626 exposure is held as wstETH ERC4626 vault shares, so emergencyWithdraw frees only dust and leaves the position illiquid.
findings.impact: The standard Yearn emergency path fails during time-sensitive recovery unless operators know to run the manual redeem/unwrap sequence.
findings.recommendation: Override Strategy4626._emergencyWithdraw to redeem vault shares, unwrap wstETH, and swap stETH to WETH using an ERC4626-aware amount cap.

findings.title: Lido withdrawal initiation returns an encoded array but keeper claim decodes a scalar request id
findings.summary: _initiateLSTWithdrawal returns abi.encode(uint256[] requestIds), while _claimLSTWithdrawal expects abi.decode(bytes,(uint256)).
findings.impact: Keeper automation using the returned bytes directly can fail to clear pendingRedemptions, delaying reports until manual correction.
verification: Code-level ABI validation; existing tests decode the returned array and re-encode requestIds[0] before claim.
findings.recommendation: Return abi.encode(requestIds[0]) for the single-request flow or update claim logic to decode and handle uint256[].

findings.title: StrategyAprOracle returns a fixed APR for every strategy and debt delta
findings.summary: aprAfterDebtChange ignores _strategy and _delta and always returns 4e16.
findings.impact: If used in production allocation, it can misprice impaired, capped, shutdown, or negative-yield strategies.
verification: Code-level validation; function body is a constant return.
findings.recommendation: Do not deploy this as a production allocator oracle; compute bounded APR from real stETH/wstETH/vault state and return zero for unavailable strategies.
